description: Low-level garbage collector inspection and manipulation.

functions.name: get_total
functions.description: Returns the GC's current tracked memory total in bytes.

returns.description: The number of bytes currently tracked by the GC.

functions.name: set_total
functions.description: Directly overrides the GC's tracked memory total. Useful for hiding allocations from GC pressure calculations. Use with care — setting this too low can cause the GC to trigger too aggressively; too high and it may never trigger.

params.name: bytes
params.description: The value to set as the GC total.

functions.name: run_full_gc
functions.description: Immediately triggers a full GC collection cycle.
